actual.definition: 因子无关组合输入和目标权重/仓位/调仓建议及诊断
actual.input: 已批准分数/股票池/账户/权益/暴露
actual.acceptance: 不依赖具体因子名称，不修改账本

actual.definition: 单/多因子组合、等权/分数权、LongOnly
actual.acceptance: 零分/负分/整手余数有定义，权重守恒
不得用long-only冒充多空，P5另测真实模拟约束

actual.definition: 单票/总敞口/净敞口/杠杆/换手限制
actual.acceptance: 等号/越界/冲突约束测试，不静默放宽
缺暴露不视为0，容差明确

actual.definition: 可交易性/空头许可/借券/可售数量检查
actual.acceptance: 停牌/借券不足显式拒绝，P5提交撮合再检查

actual.definition: 风险拒单及不可行组合显式错误，不可绕过
actual.acceptance: 调用方不能强制忽略拒绝；实际订单接线P5测

actual.golden_case_overrides: Each Golden explicitly states changed prices/lots/weights/limits; each full fixture must freeze all values and hashes before execution. No implicit risk disabling or solver.
actual.rules_not_modelled_as_real_execution: No real commissions, borrow fees, settlement, exchange matching, broker, orders or fills. Fee reserve is explicit engineering buffer; P5 separately implements its approved synthetic event/ledger contract.
